content: This is a nice set of wheels. How much did the dealer charge you for this?
A lot. I probably got to moonlight for the rest of my life, but so what, it's worth it. Come on, get in. Let's take a drive.
Okay then, let's go fast! Whoa! This thing can really accelerate fast.
Check out what happens when I put on the brakes suddenly. It can stop quickly.
Hey, just watch out for cops or you're gonna end up in the slammer. You know you tend to go fast?
Yes, I know it. I went through my last set of tires fast. I even had three flat tires in two weeks.
Now watch. . . some guys probably run a light and hit your car.
